title: Research: flag-2 basis head never hosted on published P104 channel (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

One-flag follow-up to [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. That census already shows the basis head meets the target final on only 4 of 208 matched flags. This package pins one of the other 204: flag 2 (`X1` → `Y84`, basis head `488`).

On the published 4,058-event word:

- `X1` starts at `[488]` and drops `488` at transport event 494
- every annotated `Y84` frame avoids `488`
- the `Y84` final excludes `488`
- no event names both endpoints

The published channel therefore cannot chronologically host a basis-head coefficient or dirty-restore that source line into the matched target along this flag's geometry.

**Scoped obstruction. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. A changed schedule that does host the head is outside this package.

## Result

Package: `research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit/`.
Tip: `06b130eda28e638c58b333346f85b187e8012f25`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_ABSENT_HEAD_FLAG2 flag=2 head=488 target_hosting=0 drop_event=494 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_ABSENT_HEAD_FLAG2_INDEPENDENT flag=2 head=488 target_hosting=0 drop_event=494 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_ABSENT_HEAD_FLAG2_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-absent-head-flag2-audit outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) for the 4/208 final-head census. This package does not reopen that full restoration count, the #3259 cut, [#3386](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3386), [#3374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3374), or the merged readout series through [#2883](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2883).

Credit Nick Petalas / #2981, jwr404 / #3242, and the reviewed #1991 channel. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
